headline: Slancha presents Hanging Baskets referencing David Bowie, brutalism and the Romans
context: From laser-cut steel to melted polystyrene waste, 10 designers have reinterpreted the humble hanging basket for a London Design Festival exhibition curated by design gallery Slancha. Dangling chains and elaborate 3D-printed cups also feature among the 10 hanging baskets displayed

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: From laser-cut steel to melted polystyrene waste, 10 designers have reinterpreted the humble hanging basket for a London Design Festival exhibition curated by design gallery Slancha. Dangling chains and elaborate 3D-printed cups also feature among the 10 hanging baskets displayed in the Hackney studio of fashion agency and retailer Awaykin.
